records.contract: POST data is the caller body merged with wikidot_token7; Content-Type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8, User-Agent is WikidotPy, Referer is https://www.wikidot.com/, and cookies use the Cookie header.
wikidot_token7 defaults to 123456 in the cookie store, its current cookie value is injected into every form body, and an explicit caller body field wins because the caller body is unpacked last.

Cookie entries preserve insertion order and serialize as name=value; with a trailing semicolon; names reject non-strings, empty text, whitespace, equals, and semicolon; values reject serialized whitespace and semicolon.
A non-empty WIKIDOT_SESSION_ID on HTTP is rejected before requests unless allow_insecure_session_transport_for exactly equals the target site UNIX name.
An explicitly allowed authenticated HTTP request disables environment proxy trust; local_base_url requests also disable environment proxy trust.

Non-www sites are probed by HTTPS without following redirects; 404 raises NotFoundException, request errors and other HTTP errors fail closed with WikidotTransportSecurityException, and www is treated as HTTPS.

A probe redirect is accepted only for the exact same hostname, no explicit port or credentials, and HTTP or HTTPS; same-site HTTP marks SSL unsupported, while a missing or invalid Location fails closed.
AMC POST redirects are never followed and any 3xx response raises WikidotTransportSecurityException immediately without retry.
HTTP status and request errors retry with capped exponential backoff through attempt_limit; exhaustion raises AMCHttpStatusCodeException with the HTTP status or sentinel 999.
Non-JSON and non-object JSON responses retry through attempt_limit; exhaustion raises ResponseDataException without exposing the raw payload.
An empty JSON object retries through attempt_limit; exhaustion raises ResponseDataException.
A missing status retries only for non-side-effecting bodies; a body containing action or event raises ResponseDataException immediately to avoid replaying an uncertain side effect.
A present non-string status retries through attempt_limit; exhaustion raises ResponseDataException.
status try_again retries for read and side-effecting bodies through attempt_limit; exhaustion raises WikidotStatusCodeException carrying try_again.
status not_ok retries only for non-side-effecting bodies; action or event bodies fail immediately with WikidotStatusCodeException.
status no_permission is terminal and raises ForbiddenException, with moduleName or action/event context when present.
Any string status other than ok, try_again, not_ok, or no_permission is terminal and raises WikidotStatusCodeException carrying that status.
status ok returns the original httpx.Response; batch results preserve input order, and return_exceptions controls whether per-item exceptions are returned or raised.

AMC-specific exceptions are WikidotTransportSecurityException, AMCHttpStatusCodeException, WikidotStatusCodeException, and ResponseDataException under AjaxModuleConnectorException; the connector also raises NotFoundException for a 404 site probe and ForbiddenException for no_permission.
